blurb: Circle B Stables offers guided horseback trail rides through Kanawha State Forest, featuring scenic loops of varying lengths and difficulty. They also provide pony rides for children, birthday parties with pony rides, riding and training classes, and group gatherings. Additional programs include horse boarding, equine internships, therapeutic learning, and exposure training for military and law enforcement.
